text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's small... I managed to leave 
my hoofprints in history, right...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's been steadily etched into you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: うん、着実に刻まれたよ
まだまだ、もっと積み重ねていこう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, it definitely left its mark.
Let's keep building on this, more and more!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Today's step will write the history of my 
future... And I'm sure it will become a 
picture scroll I can be proud of—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: I can't wait for the day you pull it off.

I'm really looking forward to the day you 
pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: 成し遂げられる日が楽しみだな
成し遂げられる日が楽しみだね
choice_data_list_en: I look forward to the day we achieve it, huh.
I look forward to the day we achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep racking up victories with 
Trainer, and then one day...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The history I yearned for is far grander 
and more dazzling than I am now—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If I am to count myself among them, I 
cannot be satisfied with the status quo...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"An even more passionate race... I must 
continue to depict the drama that is 
Chrono Genesis...!"
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got!
I'll give you my full support, too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that is truly reassuring. 
Let us forge a new history, together...
choice_data_list: 俺も全力でサポートするよ！
私も全力でサポートするよ！
